notes:
What's new in 0.9.239 (beta)
- Pit speed limit: SMART calls it once on every pit entry, and gives the number straight away when you ask.
- Brake calls on time, also while SMART is talking, and in the race as well as practice; brake targets come as "Brake at ...", about one every two laps.
- A lap readout after your laps; after a spin SMART tells you where the time went.
- In the pit box, setup questions answered in about two seconds.
- Flags: blue flags only when a lapping car is behind you; meatball and black flags called.
- After the chequered flag: no fuel call.
- Live delta only compares laps from the same sim.
- Radar and spotter ignore cars in the pit lane; in ACC a passing car shows as soon as your limiter comes off.
- Track maps show from lap one in Assetto Corsa, and before lap one in ACC on supported tracks.
- Corner lights: a key row explains every letter, with a tip on hover.
- Highlights wait until you leave the track, then cut with TV angles: onboard first, then short angles in race order.

Known issue
- If you leave GOAT running in the tray for days, quit it from the tray icon and start it again once a day. Memory use grows slowly over time; a fix is coming.
